## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The README still documents a 30-second default timeout, which this change makes false, and it should be updated with the constant. The parser change and its updated test are consistent with each other.

## Changes
The pull request raises `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT` in `app/cli.py` from 30 to 60 and updates the default assertion in `tests/test_cli.py` to match. It also adds a one-line `review.txt` at the repository root that the description does not mention and no code references.

## Important
- app/cli.py:3 — comments — Update the README's default timeout to 60 seconds — Running the command without `--timeout` now waits 60 seconds, but `README.md:3` still says "Requests time out after 30 seconds unless you pass `--timeout SECONDS`." The changed line `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 60` makes that sentence false. — Users who rely on the README will expect requests to fail after 30 seconds and will size their own timeouts and retries wrongly. — Fix: Change `README.md:3` to state 60 seconds.
